GithubConnectionConflict.description:
The GitHub connection is in the wrong state for this request. The
stable `error.code` is one of `github_operator_managed` (a token file
is configured), `github_signin_unavailable` (no GitHub App client ID,
GitHub disabled, or Helm shutting down), `github_already_connected`,
`github_not_connected` or `github_reconnect_required`.

error.message: An operator manages GitHub on this Helm with a token file.

GithubDependencyFailed.description:
GitHub could not be reached (`github_unreachable`) or refused the
request (`github_refused`). Never 502 or 504, whose bodies a proxy in
front of Helm may replace. The message is Helm's own; GitHub's text is
never included.
